assets.name: SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust
assets.description: ETF tracking the S&P 500, representing large-cap US equities across major sectors. Technology is its largest sector, so it overlaps with QQQ, NVDA and TSM.
assets.portfolio_role: Core exposure to the US equity market.

assets.name: Invesco QQQ Trust
assets.description: ETF tracking the Nasdaq-100, with significant exposure to large technology and growth companies, including NVIDIA.

assets.name: NVIDIA Corporation
assets.description: Semiconductor company and major supplier of GPUs and computing infrastructure used for AI, data centres, gaming and accelerated computing.
assets.portfolio_role: Direct exposure to the AI infrastructure investment cycle.

assets.name: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company
assets.description: One of the world's largest semiconductor foundries and a critical manufacturer of advanced chips for global technology companies. Held here through its US-listed ADR.
assets.portfolio_role: Exposure to global semiconductor manufacturing and advanced-node capacity.

assets.name: JPMorgan Chase & Co.
assets.description: Large diversified US bank operating across consumer banking, commercial banking, investment banking and asset management.
assets.portfolio_role: Exposure to the financial sector and the credit cycle.

assets.name: Exxon Mobil Corporation
assets.description: Major integrated global energy company involved in oil and natural gas production, refining and related businesses.
assets.portfolio_role: Energy exposure; a potential beneficiary of higher oil and gas prices.

assets.name: Health Care Select Sector SPDR Fund
assets.description: ETF providing diversified exposure to large US healthcare companies, including pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, healthcare equipment and services.

assets.name: Lockheed Martin Corporation
assets.description: Large US aerospace and defence company producing military aircraft, missiles, defence systems and space technology.
assets.portfolio_role: Exposure to global defence spending and geopolitical security demand.

assets.name: iShares China Large-Cap ETF
assets.description: ETF providing exposure to large Chinese companies, primarily through major listed Chinese equities.

assets.name: Vanguard Real Estate ETF
assets.description: ETF providing broad exposure to US publicly listed real estate investment trusts and real-estate-related companies.

assets.name: iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF
assets.description: ETF holding long-duration US Treasury bonds. Provides exposure to long-term US government bonds, which are highly sensitive to interest-rate changes.
assets.portfolio_role: Long-duration government bond exposure; a potential recession and flight-to-quality asset.

assets.name: iShares iBoxx $ High Yield Corporate Bond ETF
assets.description: ETF providing diversified exposure to below-investment-grade US corporate bonds.
assets.portfolio_role: Credit-risk exposure and income-oriented fixed income.

assets.name: SPDR Bloomberg 1-3 Month T-Bill ETF
assets.description: ETF holding very short-term US Treasury bills. Its price is far less sensitive to interest-rate moves than long-duration bonds.
assets.portfolio_role: Cash-like defensive allocation with very low duration.

assets.name: SPDR Gold Shares
assets.description: ETF designed to track the price of physical gold.
assets.portfolio_role: Gold exposure; a potential diversifier during inflation, currency or geopolitical stress.

assets.name: Bitcoin
assets.description: Decentralised digital asset operating on the Bitcoin blockchain. Historically highly volatile; not a defensive asset.
assets.portfolio_role: High-volatility alternative asset and crypto exposure.
